ABOUT KIWI GUIDES

Connecting people with unforgettable guided experiences

Kiwi Guides is a New Zealand marketplace designed to make it easier to discover and book trusted guided fishing, hunting and back country experiences across the country.

ABOUT US

What Kiwi Guides is about

Kiwi Guides brings customers and independent guides together in one place. Customers can explore guided trips, compare experiences and book directly through the platform, while guides can showcase their services, availability and experience.

Our goal is to help people experience more of New Zealand through knowledgeable local guides while giving guides a simple way to reach customers and manage bookings.

CONTACT US

How can we help?

Have a question about a guided trip, booking, or becoming a Kiwi Guides guide? You can email us directly at:

thebookpioneer@gmail.com

For booking questions, include the trip name and booking reference if you have one.

TERMS & CONDITIONS

Using Kiwi Guides

Kiwi Guides provides a marketplace that connects customers with independent guides and outdoor experience providers. Guides are responsible for the accuracy of their listings, availability, pricing, safety requirements, licences, permits and the delivery of their guided experience.

Customers are responsible for providing accurate booking information, following the guide’s instructions, meeting any age, fitness, licence or equipment requirements, and advising the guide of any information that may affect participation in the experience.

A booking is only confirmed once the applicable booking process has been completed. For Instant Book trips this includes successful payment. For Request to Book trips, the guide must first accept the request and any required payment must then be completed.

Cancellation, refunds & date changes

Customer cancellations: Cancellations made 30 days or more before the trip receive a 75% refund. Cancellations made 15–29 days before the trip receive a 50% refund. Cancellations made 14 days or less before the trip are not refundable.

Date changes: A guide may choose to offer a different date instead of applying the cancellation policy. Date changes are at the guide’s discretion and must be accepted by the customer.

No shows: If the customer does not attend the booked experience, no refund is provided.

Weather, river, access or safety conditions: If the guide decides conditions are unsuitable or unsafe, the guide and customer may agree to move the booking to another suitable date, or the guide may approve a full refund.

Guide cancellation: If the guide cancels the experience and a new date is not agreed, the customer receives a full refund.

Any rights that apply under New Zealand law continue to apply.

Outdoor activities such as hunting, fishing and back country travel carry inherent risks. Customers participate at their own risk and must follow all safety instructions provided by their guide.

These terms are a general platform summary and may be updated as Kiwi Guides develops. A more detailed legal version should be reviewed before the app is publicly launched.

FOR NEW ZEALAND GUIDES

Put your guiding business in front of more travellers.

Kiwi Guides connects tourists and outdoor travellers with guides throughout New Zealand. Whether you offer fly fishing, hunting, back country adventures, helicopter accessed trips, day tours or multi day experiences, Kiwi Guides gives customers one place to discover and book local guides.

WHY USE KIWI GUIDES?

Connect with tourists looking for local guides.

Your profile can showcase your experience, social media, areas you guide and more than one listing.

Reach travellers

Be found by tourists actively looking for guided New Zealand experiences.

Multiple listings

Add separate day trips, multi day trips, back country experiences and different locations.

Build your profile

Add photos, bio, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and your own website.

No added Kiwi Guides fees.

Kiwi Guides charges one booking fee of 9% + GST. There are no extra Kiwi Guides listing or platform fees added on top.

Application review: New guide applications are reviewed before the guide profile or listings are made live.
